title: Concept: Request input written to a log call (go) — review required
description: Request input written verbatim to logs in go allows forged entries and format corruption. Neutralizing the value or logging it as a structured field removes the injection.
applicability: Application code that logs values taken from HTTP requests; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged or corrupted log entries that hide activity or mislead review; MEDIUM severity.
